changelog: Add an optional Xiaohongshu lookup. Before drafting, the Skill can read one page of the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes, so the beauty note rests on the platform instead of on guesswork. This is the only step in this Skill that charges, it runs only when the user asks and confirms it, and a run that skips it still delivers the full note.

en.description: Create Xiaohongshu beauty and skincare content from product facts, routine steps, skin concerns, and audience context. This AI beauty note maker produces a 3:4 post concept, review structure, usage-scene copy, title options, cover wording, relevant hashtags, and a natural comment starter for makeup, skincare, haircare, body care, routines, comparisons, and product recommendations. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
en.summary: Turn beauty or skincare facts into a Xiaohongshu 3:4 note concept with review copy, usage scenes, titles, cover wording, and hashtags.
en.title: Zhongcao Beauty Note Maker: Skincare and Makeup Post Pack
